sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng xiǎng gěi zuì xǐhuān de Wáng lǎoshī zuò yī zhāng kǎpiàn, kěshì tā juédé zìjǐ xiě de zì bù hǎokàn.
sentences.english: Xiaoming wanted to make a card for his favorite teacher, Teacher Wang, but he thought his handwriting wasn't good.

sentences.pinyin: Jiějie Lìlì zhīdào le, duì tā shuō: "Bié dānxīn, wǒ lái bāng nǐ xiě hànzì. Nǐ xiǎng duì lǎoshī shuō shénme ne?"
sentences.english: His sister Lili found out and said to him, "Don't worry, I'll help you write the Chinese characters. What do you want to say to the teacher?"

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shuō: "Wǒ xiǎng xiě: Lǎoshī, xièxie nín! Nín jiāo wǒmen Zhōngwén, wǒmen dōu xǐhuān nín."
sentences.english: Xiaoming said, "I want to write: Teacher, thank you! You teach us Chinese, and we all like you."

sentences.pinyin: Lìlì xiào le xiào, bāng tā zài kǎpiàn shàng xiě hǎo le jǐ ge piàoliang de hànzì.
sentences.english: Lili smiled and helped him write a few beautiful Chinese characters on the card.

sentences.pinyin: Ránhòu, tāmen yīqǐ lái dào huāyuán, xuǎn le yīxiē hěn hǎokàn de huā'ér.
sentences.english: Then, they went to the garden together and picked some very nice-looking flowers.

sentences.pinyin: Dì-èrtiān zǎoshang, Xiǎomíng dàizhe kǎpiàn hé huā'ér lái dào xuéxiào.
sentences.english: The next morning, Xiaoming brought the card and flowers to school.
Before class, Xiaoming was a little nervous.

sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎoshēng de duì Wáng lǎoshī shuō: "Lǎoshī, Jiàoshījié kuàilè! Zhè shì wǒ hé jiějie sòng gěi nín de."
sentences.english: He quietly said to Teacher Wang, "Teacher, Happy Teacher's Day! This is from my sister and me to you."

sentences.pinyin: Wáng lǎoshī kàn le kàn kǎpiàn hé huā'ér, gāoxìng de xiào le: "Xièxie nǐ, Xiǎomíng! Kǎpiàn shàng de zì xiě de zhēn hǎokàn, huā'ér yě hěn piàoliang. Wǒ hěn xǐhuān."
sentences.english: Teacher Wang looked at the card and flowers and smiled happily, "Thank you, Xiaoming! The writing on the card is so beautiful, and the flowers are also very pretty. I like them very much."

sentences.pinyin: Tīng le lǎoshī de huà, Xiǎomíng gāoxìng jí le.
sentences.english: Hearing the teacher's words, Xiaoming was overjoyed.

sentences.pinyin: Tā xiǎng: Yǐhòu wǒ yào gèng nǔlì xuéxí, ràng lǎoshī tiāntiān dōu gāoxìng.
sentences.english: He thought: From now on, I will study harder to make the teacher happy every day.
